# Carnegie Learning

> > K-12 education solutions provider offering CLEAR Math, Literacy, and World Languages curriculum with AI-powered adaptive learning platforms including MATHia, MATHstream, Fast ForWord, and ClearTalk.

Carnegie Learning, based in Pittsburgh, delivers comprehensive K-12 educational solutions combining textbooks, digital platforms, and AI tutoring systems. Their portfolio includes mathematics programs (MATHia, MATHstream), literacy interventions (Fast ForWord, Lenses on Literature, Mirrors & Windows), and world language curricula (¡Qué chévere!, T'es branché?, Deutsch So Aktuell, Zhēn Bàng!).

## Key Topics

- MATHia - Adaptive math learning platform
- MATHstream - Math proficiency tracking
- Fast ForWord - Reading intervention program
- ClearTalk - AI-powered language learning
- Lenses on Literature - Literacy curriculum
- Mirrors & Windows - Literature program
- Standards Report - Student performance analytics
- APLSE Report - Adaptive Personalized Learning Score
- LiveHint - AI tutoring chatbot
- Texas Math Solution - State-aligned curriculum
- Collaborative learning strategies
- K-12 education technology
- Data-driven instruction
- Reading proficiency intervention
- World languages curriculum

## Product Overview & Solutions

- [K-12 Education Solutions Provider | Carnegie Learning](https://www.carnegielearning.com): K-12 curriculum & edtech: CLEAR Math, Literacy, Languages, Services
- [Florida Math Solutions | Carnegie Learning](https://www.carnegielearning.com/florida/math/secondary): Florida Clear Math Secondary: MATHbook & MATHia for grades 6-12
